metadata.title: Product Bricks & Streams
metadata.description: Brick map of Returnista's returns management platform: branded portal, exchanges and store credit, return operations (rules, AI agent, warranty gate), insights (dashboard, Product Return Impact Index, benchmark) and integrations with shop platforms, carriers, WMS/ERP and apps.

rootGroups.name: Shopper Returns Experience
rootGroups.description: Everything the shopper sees: portal, fees, labels, carriers and tracking.

bricks.name: Branded Returns Portal
bricks.description: Shopper-facing self-service portal on the merchant's own branding and domain: order lookup by order number and email, item and reason selection, policy-filtered options, return instructions and FAQs.

modules.name: Portal BFF
modules.description: Backend for the portal; aggregates order, policy, exchange and label calls.

modules.name: Return Request Service
modules.description: System of record for return requests and their lifecycle states.

brickDependencies.description: Evaluates eligible items, reasons, windows and fees.
Looks up the order and line items.

externalSystemsDependingOnThisBrick.description: Shoppers open the portal from shop and email links.

bricks.name: Multi-country Returns and Localisation
bricks.description: Country-specific return addresses, carriers, languages and rules so one merchant account serves several EU markets (pricing lists multi-country returns).

layers.description: Orchestration and calculation without durable state.

modules.name: Locale Resolver
modules.description: Resolves language, country and currency for a request.

modules.name: Country Configuration Service
modules.description: Stores per-country addresses, carriers and texts.

bricks.name: Paid Returns and Return Fees
bricks.description: Adjustable return fees and a payment screen with popular European payment methods for paid returns; fees can be deducted from refunds.

layers.description: Orchestration and calculation without durable state.

modules.name: Fee Calculator
modules.description: Calculates fees by policy, country and option.

modules.name: Payment Service Provider Adapter
modules.description: Connects to the payment provider for European methods.

externalSystemsThisBrickDependsOn.system: Payment service provider (iDEAL, cards and other European methods)
externalSystemsThisBrickDependsOn.description: Collects return fees; provider not disclosed on current site (2022 article named PayPal and Buckaroo).

bricks.name: Return Labels and Carrier Selection
bricks.description: Issues return labels instantly or after approval, lets shoppers choose among configured carriers, and supports merchants' own carrier contracts (Professional pack).

modules.name: Label API
modules.description: Requests labels for an approved return.

modules.name: Label Service
modules.description: Creates shipments, stores labels and tracking codes.

modules.name: Carrier Contract Service
modules.description: Stores merchant carrier accounts and Returnista default contracts.

brickDependencies.description: Books the shipment with the carrier.
Labels wait for approval when gatekeeping applies.

bricks.name: Carrier Network Integration
bricks.description: Connectors to parcel carriers listed by Returnista (bpost, Brenger, BRT, Chronopost, DHL, DPD, GLS, Mondial Relay, Nieuwhoff, PostNord, PostNL, UPS) for labels and tracking events.

modules.name: Tracking Poller
modules.description: Polls or receives carrier scan events.

modules.name: Carrier Gateway
modules.description: Normalised label and tracking interface across carriers.

externalSystemsThisBrickDependsOn.system: Parcel carriers (PostNL, DHL, DPD, UPS, GLS, bpost and others)

bricks.name: Return Tracking and Notifications
bricks.description: Visual tracking flow for shoppers and automatic emails about return shipments and refunds.

modules.name: Return Tracking Page
modules.description: Shows return status: picked up, en route, delivered, resolved.

modules.name: Notification Dispatcher
modules.description: Sends milestone emails on return events.

rootGroups.name: Revenue Retention
rootGroups.description: Turning refunds into exchanges and store credit.

bricks.name: Exchange Engine
bricks.description: Size-based and variant exchanges in the portal using real-time availability; exchanges confirmed instantly or after inspection per category; optional free exchange shipping.

modules.name: Exchange Picker
modules.description: Lets shoppers choose an alternative variant.

layers.description: Orchestration and calculation without durable state.

modules.name: Exchange Orchestrator
modules.description: Checks stock, applies rules and decides instant vs inspected exchange.

brickDependencies.description: Creates the replacement order in the shop platform.

bricks.name: Store Credit and Bonus Credit
bricks.description: Issues store credit automatically when a return is processed, with an optional bonus (up to EUR 10 or 15% per order), synced as gift cards or credit to Shopify, Magento or via API.

modules.name: Credit Ledger Service
modules.description: Ledger of issued credit and bonuses.

modules.name: Gift Card Sync Adapter
modules.description: Creates gift cards or credit in the shop platform.

brickDependencies.description: Writes credit to the shop platform.

rootGroups.name: Return Operations
rootGroups.description: Rules, approval, receipt, resolution and service.

bricks.name: Return Policy and Rules Engine
bricks.description: Return windows, eligible reasons, exceptions, fees and handling rules by product, region and shopper segment, evaluated consistently for every request.

modules.name: Policy Evaluation API
modules.description: Answers what is allowed for a request.

layers.description: Orchestration and calculation without durable state.

modules.name: Rule Evaluator
modules.description: Evaluates rule sets against request context.

bricks.name: Return Automation and AI Rule Agent
bricks.description: AI agent that helps build return rules and automate repetitive actions, plus automation runner for resolutions, order tagging and restock location assignment.

layers.description: Orchestration and calculation without durable state.

modules.name: Rule Drafting Agent
modules.description: Turns merchant intent into draft rules.

externalSystemsThisBrickDependsOn.system: Large language model provider (assumed; not disclosed)

bricks.name: Warranty, Claims and Approval Gate
bricks.description: Requires approval before labels are issued, collects answers and photos, and lets the team review damage and warranty claims centrally before refunds or exchanges (warranty flow add-on).

modules.name: Claim Intake Form
modules.description: Questions and photo upload in the portal.

bricks.name: Return Receipt and Inspection
bricks.description: Receiving and grading of returned items, inspection-dependent resolutions and restock location assignment (inferred from automation and WMS features; may run in the partner WMS instead).

layers.description: Orchestration and calculation without durable state.

brickDependencies.description: Receives inspection results from partner WMS.

bricks.name: Refund and Resolution Orchestration
bricks.description: Decides and executes refunds, exchanges or store credit when a return is approved or inspected; writes refunds back to the shop platform and deducts fees.

layers.description: Orchestration and calculation without durable state.

modules.name: Refund Write-back Adapter
modules.description: Creates refunds in the shop platform.

bricks.name: In-store Returns
bricks.description: Lets shoppers return online orders in a physical store, registered in the same return flow (listed in the pricing feature matrix).

externalSystemsDependingOnThisBrick.system: Retail POS systems (e.g. Vendit - potential Katapull sibling integration, not confirmed)

bricks.name: Return Inquiry Handling
bricks.description: Return context in helpdesk tools (Gorgias, Trengo, CM.com, Engaige) and an optional service where Returnista handles return-related inquiries on the merchant's behalf.

externalSystemsThisBrickDependsOn.system: Helpdesk and messaging tools (Gorgias, Trengo, CM.com, Engaige)

bricks.name: Return Event and Analytics Pipeline
bricks.description: Publishes return lifecycle events and loads them into the analytics mart used by dashboards, automations, webhooks and benchmarks.

modules.name: Analytics Mart
modules.description: Return facts by SKU, reason, payment method and shopper.

bricks.name: Return Insights Dashboard
bricks.description: Product- and revenue-level return rates, trends with historical comparison, exchange and store credit insights, payment method analysis and customer behaviour patterns.

bricks.name: Product Return Impact Index
bricks.description: Measures the revenue impact of returns per SKU, flags high-return SKUs and shows the reasons behind them.

layers.description: Orchestration and calculation without durable state.

bricks.name: Benchmarking and Category Insights
bricks.description: Anonymised aggregates across brands on the platform used for the annual benchmark report and category comparisons.

bricks.name: BI Export and Data Feeds
bricks.description: Connects return data to merchants' BI tools (Enterprise pack).

modules.name: BI Connector
modules.description: Pushes to warehouses or BI tools.

subGroups.name: Commerce Stack Connectors
subGroups.description: Shop, ERP, WMS and app connectors.

bricks.name: E-commerce Platform Connectors
bricks.description: Connectors for Shopify, Shopify Plus, Shopware, Magento, Lightspeed and WooCommerce (plus custom platforms on Enterprise): order and catalog import, refund, exchange and credit write-back; distributed as platform apps.

modules.name: Order Write-back Adapter
modules.description: Writes refunds, exchanges, credit and tags.

dataDependencies.description: Shopper name and email from orders.

externalSystemsThisBrickDependsOn.system: E-commerce platforms (Shopify, Shopware, Magento, Lightspeed, WooCommerce)

bricks.name: ERP, WMS and Fulfilment Connectors
bricks.description: Native return sync with WMS and fulfilment partners (Picqer, Monta/Montapacking, Active Ants, Bleckmann, QLS, ModeXpress, itsperfect WMS) and ERPs (ACA, Becosoft, itsperfect, xCore); candidate home for Katapull sibling connectors (Logic4, DeliveryMatch).

modules.name: WMS Return Sync
modules.description: Announces returns and receives inspection results.

modules.name: ERP Return Sync
modules.description: Posts returns and credit notes to ERPs.

externalSystemsThisBrickDependsOn.system: WMS and fulfilment systems (Picqer, Monta, Active Ants, Bleckmann)

bricks.name: Ecosystem App Connectors
bricks.description: Connectors to marketing (Klaviyo), loyalty (Leat), size-and-fit (Faslet, Easysize), fraud prevention (Guzco) and stock planning (Optiply, Channeldock).

modules.name: Marketing and Loyalty Adapter
modules.description: Sends return events to Klaviyo and Leat.

modules.name: Size and Fit Adapter
modules.description: Shares fit reasons with Faslet and Easysize.

modules.name: Stock Planning Adapter
modules.description: Feeds returns to Optiply and Channeldock.

externalSystemsThisBrickDependsOn.system: Ecosystem apps (Klaviyo, Leat, Faslet, Easysize, Guzco, Optiply, Channeldock)

bricks.name: Open API and Webhooks
bricks.description: Public REST API and webhooks documented at platform.returnista.com for custom integrations and partners.

bricks.name: Merchant Account, Branding and Onboarding
bricks.description: Merchant accounts, storefronts, branding (colours, logo, font, domain), users, plan and onboarding by an onboarding specialist and customer success manager.
